product_overview: C4R Platform is a mobile-first car rental web application for the Saudi market that lets users browse cars, view details and reviews, and create authenticated bookings; admins manage cars, bookings and reviews via a dedicated dashboard.
core_goals: Provide a fast, mobile-first car browsing and booking experience optimized for Arabic (RTL) users
Support authenticated booking flows with document upload and booking management
Offer admin tools for managing cars, bookings, reviews, and platform statistics
Maintain a consistent global layout, multilingual toggle (Arabic/English), and accessible navigation on mobile

features.name: Home Page Hero & Sections
features.description: Landing page with animated hero banner, car category departments, auto-scrolling reviews and partners, and FAQ accordion for quick user discovery.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View animated hero banner with CTA -> See auto-scrolling customer reviews marquee -> Expand FAQ accordion item -> Collapse FAQ accordion item
Navigate to / -> Click department card for regular rentals -> Navigate to /cars
Navigate to / -> Click department card for With Driver -> Navigate to /with-driver
Navigate to / -> Click department card for Corporate -> Navigate to /corporate
Navigate to / -> See loading spinner while reviews load -> See reviews marquee populate with recent reviews
Navigate to / -> See error or empty state in reviews marquee when /api/reviews/recent fails

features.name: Cars Browsing
features.description: Browse all available cars in a responsive grid, inspect summary details on cards, and open a car's detail page.
user_flows: Navigate to /cars -> See loading spinner while data loads -> View cars grid layout showing image, name, year, region, price per day and rating -> Click a car card to navigate to car detail page -> Navigate to /cars/[id]
Navigate to /cars -> See loading spinner while data loads -> See empty state message when no cars available
Navigate to /cars -> See error toast when /api/cars returns an error

features.name: Car Detail View
features.description: Inspect a single car with large images, full specifications, pricing, customer reviews, and a Book Now call-to-action.
user_flows: Navigate to /cars/[id] -> View large car image -> See car name, year, region, price per day, availability status and category -> Read customer reviews with ratings and comments -> Click Book Now button -> Navigate to /booking/[id] (auth required)
Navigate to /cars/[id] -> Click Book Now button while not authenticated -> Redirect to /auth/login -> See prompt to login to continue booking
Navigate to /cars/[id] -> See error message when /api/cars/:id or /api/reviews/car/:carId fails

features.name: User Login
features.description: Authenticate users with email and password to access protected features (bookings, dashboards).
user_flows: Navigate to /auth/login -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Click Login button -> See Arabic success toast on successful login -> Get redirected to / or returnUrl
Navigate to /auth/login -> Fill email input field -> Fill incorrect password -> Click Login button -> See Arabic error toast on failed login
Navigate to /auth/login -> Click link to navigate to /auth/register
Navigate to /auth/login -> Click link to navigate to /auth/forgot-password

features.name: User Registration
features.description: Create a new user account with name, email and password to enable bookings and profile management.
user_flows: Navigate to /auth/register -> Fill name input field (min 2 characters) -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field (min 6 characters) -> Fill confirm password input field -> Click Register button -> See success toast and redirect to /auth/login
Navigate to /auth/register -> Fill invalid or short password -> Click Register button -> See error toast on validation failure
Navigate to /auth/register -> Fill email that already exists -> Click Register button -> See error toast on duplicate email

features.name: Forgot Password
features.description: Request a password reset email by submitting an account email address.
user_flows: Navigate to /auth/forgot-password -> Fill email input field -> Click submit button to request reset link -> See confirmation message after submission
Navigate to /auth/forgot-password -> Fill invalid or unregistered email -> Click submit button -> See error toast indicating failure to send reset link

features.name: Reset Password
features.description: Set a new password using a reset token received by email.
user_flows: Navigate to /auth/reset-password -> Enter reset token from email -> Enter new password (min 6 characters) -> Click submit to reset password -> See success message and ability to login
Navigate to /auth/reset-password -> Enter expired or invalid reset token -> Enter new password -> Click submit -> See error message indicating invalid token

features.name: Car Booking
features.description: Create a booking for a specific car by entering rental details, uploading required documents, and submitting the request (authenticated flow).
user_flows: Navigate to /cars/[id] -> Click Book Now button -> Navigate to /booking/[id] (auth required) -> If authenticated, Fill phone number -> Select start date -> Select end date -> Enter kilometers per day -> Enter number of days -> Upload ID card image -> Upload driver license image -> See calculated total price -> Click submit to create booking -> See success toast on booking creation
Navigate to /cars/[id] -> Click Book Now button while not authenticated -> Redirect to /auth/login -> Login -> Redirect back to /booking/[id] -> Continue booking flow
Navigate to /booking/[id] -> Fill phone number incorrectly or omit required document -> Click submit -> See error toast on validation failure

features.name: User Dashboard
features.description: Authenticated user area to view and manage own bookings, reviews, and profile information.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/user -> See list of own bookings with status (pending, approved, rejected) -> View own reviews -> Update profile information -> Click save -> See success confirmation
Navigate to /dashboard/user -> Click change password -> Fill current and new password -> Click submit -> See success or error message
Navigate to /dashboard/user while unauthenticated -> Redirect to /auth/login

features.name: Admin Dashboard
features.description: Admin panel to manage platform data: cars CRUD, booking approvals/rejections, reviews moderation, and view platform statistics.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/admin -> View statistics overview (total cars, bookings, reviews, users) -> Click Add new car -> Fill name, year, region, pricePerDay, imageUrl, category -> Click submit -> See new car in list
Navigate to /dashboard/admin -> Select existing car -> Edit car details -> Click save -> See updated car in list
Navigate to /dashboard/admin -> View all bookings -> Approve a pending booking -> See booking status change to approved
Navigate to /dashboard/admin while not an admin -> See access denied or redirect to /auth/login

features.name: Navigation & Layout
features.description: Global responsive layout with navbar, mobile bottom navigation, floating contact icons, footer and breadcrumbs for consistent navigation and quick contact.
user_flows: From any page -> Click logo in navbar -> Navigate to /
From any page -> Click navbar link 'Cars' -> Navigate to /cars
From any page -> Toggle language between Arabic and English -> See UI language update
On small screens -> Use mobile hamburger menu -> Open mobile menu -> Click link -> Navigate to selected route
On mobile -> Use bottom navigation -> Tap tab -> Navigate to corresponding route
From any page -> Click floating WhatsApp icon -> Open WhatsApp contact
From any page -> Click floating email icon -> Open email compose
From any page -> Use breadcrumbs -> Click breadcrumb segment -> Navigate to corresponding route
From any page -> Click navbar user dropdown while not logged in -> See Login/Register options

features.name: Logout
features.description: Sign out the current authenticated user, clear session, and return to the public site.
user_flows: While authenticated -> Click Logout from user dropdown in navbar -> Call /api/auth/logout -> See Arabic success toast confirming logout -> Get redirected to /
While authenticated -> Click Logout from user dropdown -> Network error on /api/auth/logout -> See error toast and remain logged in
